name: Point Plane Test Traversal
definition: A traversal algorithm for TET-AMR refinement trees that identifies the child tetrahedron containing a sample point by performing plane tests against the midpoints of the parent tetrahedron's edges.
summary: Point Plane Test Traversal locates a query point in a tetrahedral refinement tree by traversing from root to leaf using geometric half-space tests against planes defined by edge midpoints.
